🔍 Data Hygiene & Sanitization Assessment
✓ District Harmonization & Spelling Normalization
Standardized 4 major historical district spelling variants in raw data (BARAGARH → BARGARH, BOLANGIR → BALANGIR, NAWARANGHPUR → NAWARANGPUR, MALKANAGIRI → MALKANGIRI). The processed dataset cleanly represents all 30 official revenue districts.
✓ Spurious Sundargarh Duplication Filtered
Raw annual datasets from 2019–2024 contained duplicated summary tables appended under the Sundargarh district (67,952 rows). The ingestion pipeline successfully filtered all unauthentic blocks, resulting in exactly 0 location-date duplicates in the unified matrix.
✓ Zero Target Leakage & Physical Lag Windows
All 1d, 2d, 3d, and 7d lag features along with 3d, 7d, 15d, and 30d rolling accumulation sums/max strictly apply antecedent shifts (shift(1)) isolated by station groups. Day T precipitation is completely excluded from historical accumulation windows.
ℹ️ Imbalanced Target Distribution (Base Flood Rate: 2.638%)
Flooding is a sparse disaster event. Evaluation models must be assessed via Precision-Recall AUC and calibrated F1 rather than raw accuracy.
